# Vicki Collins Acupuncture & Chinese Herbal Medicine

> Registered Acupuncturist & Chinese Herbal Medicine Practitioner in Machans Beach, Cairns, Queensland, Australia.
> Over 20 years' experience, specialising in fertility and women's health.

Generated 2026-08-09 from practice.json — do not hand-edit.

## Practitioner

Vicki Collins — Bachelor of Health Science (Acupuncture), distinction, 2003.
Registered with Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (AHPRA): https://www.ahpra.gov.au/registration/registers-of-practitioners.aspx
Member: Australian Acupuncture and Chinese Medicine Association (AACMA); Chinese Medicine Board of Australia (CMBA)

## Services

- Fertility Acupuncture & IVF/IUI Cycle Support: Acupuncture sessions timed around natural conception attempts or an IVF/IUI cycle, provided alongside your medical fertility treatment.
- Women's Health Acupuncture: Acupuncture and Chinese herbal medicine for menstrual health, pregnancy support and the transition through menopause.
- Chinese Herbal Medicine: Individually formulated powdered herbal formulas prescribed after a Chinese medicine consultation.
- Acupuncture: Treatment using fine sterilised single-use needles, which may be combined with moxibustion, cupping or electro acupuncture.

## Pricing

All consultations $95.
Chinese herbal consultation $80 plus the cost of the herbs.
Listed practitioner for major Australian health funds.
